response.body: The inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear must be provided, and its effectiveness must be recorded as a critical control verification before the task proceeds. This clause applies to activities archived under LIFTING-AND-SUSPENDED-LOADS at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop.
